entities.name: Serra inquisitors
entities.description: Priests and judges of the people of Aysen on Ulgrotha, devoted to Serra, who have started a witch-hunt against the Death speakers.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Region of Ulgrotha whose people the inquisitors shepherd.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure in whose name the inquisitors act.

entities.name: Serra Paladin
entities.description: Order with more common-folk ideas than the inquisitors.

entities.name: Death speakers
entities.description: A small faction practicing divination and spirit magic, persecuted by the inquisitors.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Equipped the Death Speakers with spell books hoping the schism would grow.

events.summary: The inquisitors start a witch-hunt against the Death speakers, raiding homes and convicting them of corruption.
events.quote: the Inquisitors have started a witch-hunt

events.summary: Baron Sengir equips the Death Speakers with books of spells and dark knowledge to grow the schism.
events.quote: Baron Sengir took notice of this and started to equip the Death Speakers with actual books of spells and dark knowledge
